description: Lean 4 formalization project for information geometry unifying Condensed Matter, Noncommutative Geometry, and Quantum Gravity. Features the ultimate theoretical capstone: formal verification of the Minkowski causal cone as a Class DIII Topological Superconductor, with Andreev boundary scattering and Hayden-Preskill fast scrambling preserved by Fibonacci anyon / MZM microstates. The structural closure is governed by the Kasparov Intersection Product on a Doubled Krein space, absorbing the chiral anomaly into the non-orientable Klein Bottle topology.
